archetype: Burst-oriented hybrid of a keydown (hurricane-type) class and a combo class. The class doc describes her as sitting between archer and thief identity: most damage lands inside a short burst window, she has no gauge and no map summons to manage, and her kit is built around linking skills together - linking is not cosmetic, because linking reduces the cooldown of Unicorn Spike, Wrath of Enlil, Spikes Royale and the tree portion of Spirit of Elluel by 1 second per link. Weapon multiplier 1.3x and base attack speed stage 4 per Grandis Library. She brings three party debuffs with 100% uptime: 55% defense reduction from Spikes Royale (with the Armorbreak hyper), 30% party damage from Unicorn Spike, and touch-damage nullification, which the class doc says only Mercedes and Night Lord can provide consistently.

linkSkill.name: Elven Blessing
linkSkill.effect: Active teleport back to Elluel with a permanent passive EXP bonus. On Mercedes herself the level 3 version additionally grants +5% Damage; the linked version granted to other characters is EXP only.
linkSkill.levels: Link skill: Lv.1 +10% EXP, Lv.2 +15% EXP, Lv.3 +20% EXP (1800 sec cooldown). Mercedes' own copy: Lv.1 +10%, Lv.2 +15%, Lv.3 +20% EXP and +5% Damage (600 sec cooldown).

legionEffect.effect: Skill Cooldown -2/3/4/5/6% (capped at -5 seconds) across the five Legion rank tiers.

priority.node: All nine of Mercedes' used skills must end up boosted - the partition into trios matters far less than the coverage
priority.why: The class doc states plainly that the combination you end up with does not ultimately matter, that a good early combination only makes node management easier at low level, and that everything works out as long as all nine skills are eventually maxed. It also ties this to 6th job: the 4th job skills have to be boosted in order to level 6th job. Corroborated indirectly: mastermysty's independent cross-class reference names exactly nine Mercedes skills across its three trios (Unicorn Spike, Ishtar's Ring, Stunning Strikes, Leaf Tornado, Spikes Royale, Wrath of Enlil, Rising Rush, Lightning Edge, Elemental Knights), the same count the doc refers to.

Grandis Library places Ishtar's Ring's node group in its top tier on every retrieval. It is the skill you fall back to whenever you are not comboing, three of the five hyper passives feed it, and post-6th-job those hypers also apply to Ishtar's Brand. mastermysty likewise puts it in a bossing trio in both of the setups it lists.

priority.node: Leaf Tornado, Spikes Royale and Wrath of Enlil (these three share a node group)
priority.why: Grandis Library lists these three together as one node group and ranks that group at or near the top of its tiering. mastermysty independently recommends exactly this three-skill trio as the bossing-plus-mobbing trio. Wrath of Enlil is the class's highest-damage single skill per the class doc, Spikes Royale carries the 55% defense-reduction debuff, and Leaf Tornado is the main grinding skill.

The class doc calls it the second highest damage skill after Wrath of Enlil and notes its debuff raises party damage by 30%, comparable to an extra guild skill, so it should always be applied. Grandis Library places it in a mid tier.

priority.node: Guided Arrow (5th job skill node) - level it early if it gets you to a one-shot
priority.why: The only explicit node-leveling instruction that survives in the class doc as readable text: if leveling Guided Arrow brings you to a one-shot on the mobs you are farming, prioritise it, because it lifts your training rates while you are still in Arcane River. The doc otherwise advises crafting skill nodes rather than leveling them, since skill nodes are harder to level.

priority.node: Do not boost Swift Dual Shot, Piercing Storm or Parting Shot
priority.why: The class doc says these three are not used after their job advancements and there is no reason to boost them. Grandis Library puts all three in its lowest tier. Note this is one lineage agreeing with itself - Grandis credits its boost node build to the class doc.

usageFacts.claim: Burst order post-6th-job: apply the Spikes Royale and Unicorn Spike debuffs and Ishtar's Brand first, then pop buffs from lowest to highest impact, then Irkalla's Wrath, then Unfading Glory. Freud's Wisdom should always be used alongside Unfading Glory.

Post-6th-job damage pattern: keep comboing for the whole duration of Spirit of Elluel. Outside Spirit windows comboing is still technically better, but the gap over minimal comboing with Unicorn Spike and Wrath of Enlil is much smaller.
A cooldown hat also lowers the cooldown of the Spirit Enchant versions of the 6th job skills, and of Erda Fountain / Sol Janus.

hexa.notes: NO SOURCED HEXA INVESTMENT ORDER EXISTS FOR MERCEDES IN PUBLIC. Two reasons, both verified: (1) the class doc deliberately does not publish a fixed order - it points readers at maplescouter.com/hexa ('Analysis/Optimization' -> 'Hexa Core') after building a character preset, i.e. it treats the order as per-character output, not a list; (2) the 'indicative upgrade order' the doc does include is an embedded image that the text export does not carry. The doc's prose around that image says the chart includes all four mastery cores, and elsewhere (in the combo section) that at the time of writing only the first two mastery cores were live in GMS - which also means any order lifted from that doc is keyed to a 2025-06 GMS core release state and is stale against v.271. Grandis Library has no HEXA section at all for any class. maplescouter is Korean-language and KMS-balance. If MaplePlanner wants to ship a Mercedes HEXA order it must come from the Mercedes Discord or from modelling maplescouter's method; do not synthesise one.

hyperStats.notes: No source read this session gives a Mercedes hyper stat allocation. The class doc has no hyper stats section at all (it has a hyper SKILLS section); Grandis Library carries no hyper stat data for any class; mastermysty covers boost nodes only. One class-specific fact does bear on hyper stat allocation and is mechanically sourced: Vicious Shot lets Critical Rate exceed 100% and converts Critical Rate into Critical Damage for its duration (21% of crit rate at Lv.1 scaling to 50% at Lv.30), so crit rate does not become dead once you are at the cap the way it does for most classes. Leaving the priority list null rather than inventing one.

passives.why: Raises the Spikes Royale defense-reduction debuff from 35% to 55%. The class doc treats it as automatic, and it is the reason Mercedes needs no IED lines on weapon/secondary/emblem.
One of the three Ishtar's Ring passives the class doc takes as standard; post-6th-job the Ishtar's Ring hypers also apply to Ishtar's Brand, which the doc gives as the reason they hold their value.
Second of the three standard Ishtar's Ring passives; same Ishtar's Brand carry-over reasoning.
Third of the three standard Ishtar's Ring passives; same Ishtar's Brand carry-over reasoning.

flexPick.guidance: The class doc marks Spikes Royale - Temper Link as the recommended pick and says it can be the difference between one-shotting and not while training. It recommends Water Shield - True Immunity 1 instead for bosses that apply frequent abnormal statuses (it names Lotus, Gloom and Verus Hilla), and says True Immunity can be dropped once you have enough status resistance from other sources such as a high level Legion artifact or the Cygnus link. Below level 200, a point in Water Shield - Reinforce if you feel too squishy, to be reassigned later - the doc notes this does not reduce boss damage taken. Grandis Library's list of options adds Spikes Royale - Reinforce and Water Shield - Reinforce alongside the doc's two.

actives.note: These are the three hyper actives on the class's hyper skill list, one per unlock level, so there is no selection to make. Wrath of Enlil matters far beyond its hyper-active status: the class doc treats it as the highest-damage single skill, it is a boost node target, and it is one of the four skills whose cooldown drops by 1 second per skill link.

hyperSkills.notes: The passive set is a single-lineage claim: Grandis Library credits its Hyper Passive Build to the Class Doc, so doc + Grandis is one source, not two. No independent confirmation was reachable. The only other page found with a Mercedes hyper list, digitaltq.com, has a changelog whose sole entry is dated 2021 and lists a different set including Spikes Royale - Reinforce; it predates 6th job entirely and was rejected rather than counted.

Grandis Library lists the same three lines for bossing, but its credits attribute Inner Ability to the Class Doc, so it is a restatement rather than a second opinion.

The class doc's own framing is looser: it says a meso line in the first or second slot while grinding is fine and is a personal-preference trade of damage for income, and that drop rate is a strong line to run because it affects Oz boxes, pitched boss drops, nodestones and 6th job Sol Erda and Sol Erda Fragments.

critRateIsNotOptional.claim: Crit rate cannot be skipped on Mercedes (nor on any archer class, per the doc), because Vicious Shot converts crit rate into crit damage - the doc values the line at roughly 10% crit damage. You can play without it, but the doc calls it a considerable damage loss to be fixed eventually.

alternatives.verdict: Not recommended to keep. Mercedes reaches the attack speed cap without it. Only worth holding as a stopgap if you cannot roll boss damage or are out of honor, where it saves a node slot on Decent Speed Infusion or avoids needing a green potion.
Called extremely viable by the doc because it affects Oz boxes, pitched boss drops, nodestones and 6th job Sol Erda / Sol Erda Fragments.
Fine as a first or second line while grinding; an explicit personal-preference trade of damage for income.

Playable but uncompetitive: hyper skills cannot be cooldown-skipped, so the only worthwhile targets are Unicorn Spike, the Angelic Buster link and Water Shield (plus Hero's Echo and the Kritias ring, minor). The doc rates it better than Attack +21 and says keep it if you enjoy it.
Worse than Damage to monsters with an abnormal status; acceptable only when short on honor.

steps: Roll 20% crit rate onto the 2nd or 3rd line first, with honor or circulators - it is the rarest second/third line (tied with buff duration), so targeting it first spends less honor overall.
Lock the crit rate line and roll the remaining line for 7/8% damage to abnormal status (or your chosen third line).
Use chaos or black circulators to max the values on lines 2 and 3; expect to be sitting on a boss damage first line while doing this.
Lock lines 2 and 3 and reroll the first line manually for 20% boss damage; if honor runs low, hold on any first line until the next event.
rollingOrder.serverNote: Outside Reboot, circulator rolling gets expensive, so the doc suggests rolling with honor only apart from event-granted circulators. On Heroic/Reboot circulators are the normal tool.

gearingNotes: CRIT RATE BEHAVES DIFFERENTLY ON THIS CLASS. Vicious Shot allows Critical Rate to exceed 100% and turns crit rate into crit damage for its duration - 21% of crit rate at Lv.1, rising 1% per level to 50% at Lv.30 - and most of Mercedes' damage is dealt inside that window. Crit rate therefore keeps scaling past the point where it would be dead weight on other classes, which is why the class doc refuses to drop the inner ability crit rate line and why it warns that Kinesis' Judgment link underperforms on Vicious Shot. ATTACK SPEED: Mercedes caps at 10 without any inner ability - base 4, Elven Grace 5, booster 7, Ignis Roar 8, Decent Speed Infusion and green potion 10. Ignis Roar gives +1 attack speed from a single stack and breaks the soft cap; the doc says it is a large final damage boost and stacks should never be allowed to drop. Note that the two skills carrying the burst, Ishtar's Ring and Irkalla's Wrath, are keydown skills unaffected by attack speed - the investment is for combo speed, safety and smoother grinding rotations. IED: because Spikes Royale with the Armorbreak hyper applies a 55% defense reduction, the doc says Mercedes needs no IED lines on weapon/secondary/emblem and that visual IED as low as 93% is acceptable in the mid game. WSE: the doc's current ideal is 8 lines attack / 1 line boss damage / 0 IED, with the boss line preferably on the secondary (the weapon gives 1% more attack per line than the secondary due to its level, while boss lines are equal on both), or 7/2/0; it advises running a calculator because the answer is character-specific, and notes the gap between 8/1/0 and 7/2/0 is larger on non-Reboot servers where bonus potential attack% exists. Best secondary per the doc is the Princess No secondary. If you do end up with IED lines, the doc says drop IED from the Legion artifact in favour of boss damage, then DEX or crit rate. COOLDOWN HAT: breakpoints are -2 and -5 seconds and nothing in between does anything. The doc recommends a -2 second hat for both mains and bossing mules and says a stat hat has become suboptimal over the 6th job patches; -5 seconds it calls unrealistic for Reboot/Heroic. The more cooldown reduction you carry, the more you must actively combo to come out ahead. LEGION ARTIFACT: the doc's six most important stats are Critical Rate 20%, Boss Damage 15%, Damage 15%, All Stats 150, Critical Damage 4%, Ignore Enemy Defense 20%.

commonMistakes.mistake: Playing Mercedes as a pure keydown class - holding Ishtar's Ring and never linking skills
commonMistakes.detail: The class doc calls this the least damage possible short of not attacking, and sets a minimum standard of using the linked skills off cooldown. It is also a node problem: linking is what reduces the cooldowns of Unicorn Spike, Wrath of Enlil, Spikes Royale and the Spirit of Elluel tree by 1 second each time.

commonMistakes.mistake: Over-committing to combos when the safe play was to reposition
commonMistakes.detail: The doc says learning when not to combo is harder than learning the combos, and names over-committing as a mistake experienced Mercedes players still make. Half-comboing or falling back to Ishtar's Ring is explicitly fine.

commonMistakes.mistake: Letting Ignis Roar stacks fall off
commonMistakes.detail: A single stack is worth +1 attack speed past the soft cap and the skill is a large final damage boost; the doc says it should never be dropped. Note that cancelling Gust Dive with Leaf Tornado does not add a stack.

commonMistakes.mistake: Not keeping the Unicorn Spike and Spikes Royale debuffs applied before and during burst
commonMistakes.detail: Unicorn Spike is 30% party damage and Spikes Royale is 55% defense reduction, both 100% uptime debuffs; the doc's burst instruction is to have both applied (plus Ishtar's Brand post-6th-job) before bursting.

commonMistakes.mistake: Cancelling Gust Dive with Leaf Tornado in a combo where Stunning Strikes was supposed to link out of it
commonMistakes.detail: The Leaf Tornado cancel is the standard way to kill Gust Dive's endlag, but using it where the combo wanted a Stunning Strikes link costs you the 1 second cooldown reduction from that link.

commonMistakes.mistake: Spending nodestones boosting Swift Dual Shot, Piercing Storm or Parting Shot
commonMistakes.detail: None of the three are used after their job advancements.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: 'Ishtar's Brand' does not exist as a game string. maplestorywiki v270 calls it Ishtar's Mark ('the enemy is branded with Ishtar's Mark'); the substring 'Brand' appears 0 times on the Mercedes skill page. The class doc writes 'Ishtar Brand' (no apostrophe-s). The file's 'Ishtar's Brand' matches neither source and appears 4 times in load-bearing text: hexa.usageFacts burst order, hyperSkills.passives[1].why, hyperSkills.passives[2].why (via the Ishtar's Brand carry-over reasoning), and commonMistakes[3].detail. This is the one genuine name defect found.

ALLOWLIST NOT ENFORCED (not fabrication, but the anti-fabrication mechanism is broken): skillNameReference declares 'do not emit a name that is not here', yet the file emits Vicious Shot (4x, and the entire gearingNotes crit-rate argument plus hyperStats.notes rest on it), Elven Grace (attack-speed chain in gearingNotes), and Swift Dual Shot (vMatrix.priority[5] and nodeGroupsPerGrandis). All three are confirmed real on maplestorywiki v270 - Vicious Shot is an active, Master Level 30, Lv.1 '+21% of Critical Rate' and Lv.30 '+50% of Critical Rate', matching the gearing note exactly - but none are in the allowlist, which has no 1st-job section at all.

NO OTHER FABRICATION FOUND. Independently verified as real against maplestorywiki v270: all 13 node skill names listed in vMatrix.notes; all 12 HEXA mastery skill names; all 4 enhancementCores, and their classification as HEXA Enhancements (Level Requirement 260) rather than V Enhancements is correct; Unfading Glory as Origin and Primeval Spirits as Ascent; all 12 hyper skill names including the distinct 'Elvish Blessing' (hyper active) vs 'Elven Blessing' (link skill); and Staggering Strikes vs Stunning Strikes as two genuinely separate skills rather than a duplication error.
